audience: dental offices that run Open Dental and want to check open chair time and the office setup

useCases.title: Find open chair time for a provider
useCases.text: Ask for the open slots of a provider and operatory in the next 14 days. Match the provider and operatory numbers to names from the office lists.

useCases.title: Map the office setup before a schedule change
useCases.text: Read the clinics, providers, operatories and appointment types of the office in one review. Use the lists to check names, rooms and hidden items.

useCases.title: Check the procedure codes behind each appointment type
useCases.text: Read the appointment types, which list the procedure codes each type requires. Then read the office procedure codes to see their ADA codes and categories.

useCases.title: Explain a refused call with the API permissions
useCases.text: Read which API permissions the customer key has, such as ReadAll. Use the answer to explain why an Open Dental request was refused.
